#+TITLE: 38 dot-emacs cli bundle
#+STARTUP: overview

* Dev process setup
  Before executing ANY work item in this plan, open and obey
  the rules defined in this project's per-repo instructions:

    - .github/copilot-instructions.md  (mirrored in CLAUDE.md)

  Both auto-load into every GHCP CLI session.  Read the current
  rules there and follow them.  This plan intentionally does
  not restate any rule — the per-repo instructions are the
  single source of truth.

  This plan is AUTHORED in the cluster repo and SHIPPED into the
  dot-emacs checkout on c01 by `PLAN_REPO=/workspace/dot-emacs
  bin/plan-route.sh` (ship mode, cluster 2026-09-26).  It executes
  in /workspace/dot-emacs.  The authored copy is
  cluster:.github/REPL/38.dot-emacs.cli.bundle.org.txt.

* Context
  - SOURCE of `cli`: cluster repo bin/cli-sessions.sh (commits
    b01e15d, bb82865, df8d59d, 4c92163).  Registry ~/.copilot/sessions
    = box|session|plan|model|launched_utc; --refresh scans boxes in
    bin/fleet-ips.json (the ONLY cluster dependency -> 1.2 below).
    Fetch it: `git -C /workspace/cluster show origin/master:bin/cli-sessions.sh`
    (c01 has /workspace/cluster).
  - The bundle contract: builder = build/<flavor>/Dockerfile, packed
    by an explicit *.tar.list, extract at `/`.  root/.bashrc is
    already in
    (link "build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/amd64.tar.list" 900).
  - MEASURED 2026-09-26 model defaults:
    | file                                                   | now                          |
    |--------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------|
    | build/emacs-30.1-...-azurelinux-...-photon-5.0/.bashrc | COPILOT_MODEL=opus-4-8, h=opus-5 |
    | build/devbox-arcadia-...-photon-5.0/.bashrc            | opus-5 (uncommitted edit), h=opus-5 |
    | build/bashrc_patch                                     | opus-4-7                     |
    | build/emacs-30.1-treesitter-ubuntu-26.04/.bashrc       | h() picker, no default       |
  - PRE-EXISTING STATE on c01 — NOT THIS PLAN'S: 7 local commits
    ahead of origin (2026-09-14/15, ubuntu-26.04 builder) and 6
    modified build/ files + untracked plans 03/10.  Stage ONLY the
    files this plan touches, by explicit path.  Do not push the 7
    commits' question away by rebasing/resetting; if `git push`
    would publish them, that is fine ONLY because they are the
    user's own finished commits — record it in G3.
  - The model name on L-server is `claude-opus-5-5` (hyphen, not
    dot): `curl -s 127.0.0.1:11434/v1/models | jq -r '.data[].id' | grep opus`.
